dedupe_keys.name: prss 1 satellite imagery web portal suparco pakistan

description: The PRSS-1 web portal offers imagery from Pakistan's first remote sensing satellites, PRSS-1 and PakTES-1A, launched on 9 July 2018 into a sun-synchronous low Earth orbit. PRSS-1 carries an optical payload with a resolution of 0.98 metres panchromatic and 2.89 metres multispectral and a four-day revisit anywhere on the globe; PakTES-1A, designed by SUPARCO, gives 2.4 metres panchromatic and 4.8 metres multispectral. Two ground stations in Islamabad and Karachi plan, receive, process and archive the imagery. The portal names uses in land mapping, agriculture, urban and rural planning, environmental and natural disaster monitoring, water resources, and the monitoring and planning of CPEC infrastructure projects. It has a catalogue to browse, sample imagery, acquisition types, sign-in and registration, and a request-a-quote form. Access is by registration and quotation: imagery is sold, while PakTES-1A imagery is free of cost for academic purposes, and no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: prices and product terms are not published, and parts of the home page still carry template placeholder text. Coverage is global, with a four-day revisit anywhere on the globe. It supports hazard exposure analysis and emergency response mapping of roads, dams and other infrastructure; related records are the MYSA remote sensing open data catalogue and the PhilSA satellite imagery catalogue.
